## Objective
- Build a complete, playable browser game titled “Auctions Racers.”

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for visual checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript game with auctions, car selection, arcade racing, and season results.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built auction bidding against rivals, three collectible cars, arcade racing with steering/boost/traffic, payouts, and season progression in `index.html`.
- Verified the game in Playwright: auction bidding, race completion and payouts, and progression to the next auction.
- Checked the racing screen screenshot and confirmed the console is clear after adding an empty favicon.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally do a final gameplay/visual pass and report the completed game with brief assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/race.jpg`: Latest racing-screen visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The race is 3,200 m; race completion and placement-based payout were tested.

content.text:
Implemented **Auctions Racers** in `index.html`: bid against rivals, collect and choose from three cars, race with steering and boost, earn placement-based payouts, and progress through the season.

Verified the auction, race completion and payouts, and progression to the next auction in Playwright. Saved and reviewed the latest racing-screen screenshot at `screenshots/race.jpg`; the browser console was clear.

Assumptions: a self-contained browser game was appropriate, and the season would use the three available cars.
